description: Prepare a field-capture video upload for an EGOCENTRIC_VIDEO robotics collection program AS THE TOKEN OWNER (contributor personal token, robotics:write). Joins the program + grants consent (idempotent; set acceptConsent: true after showing the attestation) and returns a signed quarantine upload URL. PUT the video bytes to signedUrl, then call opentrain_submit_collection_contribution with {storageKey, sha256}.
name: opentrain_prepare_collection_upload
